derivations.quote:
Dividing by $V$, seven operations dominate, each a power $p^{1-g_i}$ with margin $g_i>0$ below one.

| Operation | Cost$/V$ | Power of $p$ | Margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prefix moves | $dK$ | $\epsilon(1+c)$ | $g_1=1-\epsilon(1+c)$ |
| Chunk exchanges | $pK^{\tau-1}$ | $1-\epsilon c(1-\tau)$ | $g_2=\epsilon c(1-\tau)$ |
| Layer rounds | $\ell d^{\lambda'}$ | $1-\epsilon(1-\lambda')$ | $g_3=\epsilon(1-\lambda')$ |
| Axis layouts | $d^2(1+\ell^\tau)$ | $\tau+\epsilon(2-\tau)$ | $g_4=1-\tau-\epsilon(2-\tau)$ |
| Gaussian lines | $dp^{1/2+\delta}\alpha$ | $3/4+\delta+3\epsilon/2$ | $g_5=1/4-\delta-3\epsilon/2$ |
| Chirps | $dp^\delta$ | $\epsilon+\delta$ | $g_6=1-\delta-\epsilon$ |
| Products | $\log(rp)$ | $1-\epsilon$ | $g_7=\epsilon$ |

The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md). The total is $O(p/K)K^\tau=O(pK^{\tau-1})$.
- Each of at most $\ell$ rounds costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ by [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md).

A visit is a node of the butterfly-layer or address-layout recursions, or one round or group invocation inside them. They have constant branching, depth $O(\log p)$ and polynomially many rounds and groups. Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit. The setup costs at most $p^{A+C}=o(Tp)$ Per-record and per-line setup is also small. A visit touches $O(T/r)$ records, so $O(p^C)$ address work per record sums to $O(Tp^{A+C}/r)$; at most $2dT/r$ Gaussian lines per tensor map cost $O(dTp^C/r)$. Both are $o(Tp)$ because $r$ exceeds every fixed power of $p$.

Exceptional addresses, where the packed shifts of [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md) fail, are bounded to a fraction $O(d2^{-K})$ of addresses. Let $V_{\rm call}$ be the volume of one packed change of basis. A record has $\Theta(rp)$ payload bits and an exceptional one adds an $O(p)$-bit key, so the compact stream of exceptional records has length $O\left(\frac{V_{\rm call}}{rp}d2^{-K}(rp+p)\right)=O(V_{\rm call}d2^{-K})$. Stable bit sorting makes $O(p)$ scans of it, costing $O(V_{\rm call}dp2^{-K})$. Over at most $p^A$ visits of volume $O(V)$, and with $d=O(p^\epsilon)$, the repair costs $O(Vp^{O(1)}2^{-K})=o(V)$, because $K=\Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$ beats every power of $p$.

Each of the seven powers is at most $1-2\kappa$, and any fixed power of $\log p$ is at most $p^\kappa$ eventually, which the margin $2\kappa$ leaves room for. The total is $O(Tp\,p^{1-\kappa})=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa})$

relations.quote: Cost accounting totals the running time of every step of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) and shows that it is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the saved exponent.

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits of the T coefficients of p bits, V=Tp.
symbols.quote: Let $V=Tp=\Theta(n)$ be the volume, the number of stored bits of $T$ coefficients of $p$ bits.

symbols.name: margin
symbols.meaning: The margin below one of the i-th dominant power of p, so the power is p^{1-g_i}.
symbols.quote: Dividing by $V$, seven operations dominate, each a power $p^{1-g_i}$ with margin $g_i>0$ below one.

symbols.name: visit exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that the recursions make at most p^A visits in total.
symbols.quote: Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit.

symbols.name: setup exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that descriptor setup per visit is at most p^C steps.
symbols.quote: Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit.

symbols.name: call volume
symbols.meaning: The volume of one packed change of basis.
symbols.quote: Let $V_{\rm call}$ be the volume of one packed change of basis.
